evidence.temozolomide: Stupp et al., NEJM 2005 (EORTC 26981/NCIC CE.3): RT+TMZ vs RT alone; median PFS 6.9 vs 5.0 months (overall survival HR 0.63 confirmed)
evidence.ttfields: Stupp et al., JAMA 2017 (EF-14): TTFields + TMZ vs TMZ; median PFS 6.7 vs 4.0 months (HR 0.63)
evidence.bevacizumab: Chinot et al., NEJM 2014 (AVAglio): median PFS 10.6 vs 6.2 months (HR 0.64); no overall-survival benefit (16.8 vs 16.7 months). Part of the PFS gain is imaging pseudo-response.
evidence.lomustine_pcv: no trial-derived figure used; effect not modelled
evidence.immunotherapy: no benefit shown in randomised glioblastoma trials; not modelled
